resources.string: You are on an older version. You can use the app only if you update it.
Voluntary fasting observed every Monday and Thursday
Three voluntary fasting days in the middle of each Hijri month (13th, 14th, 15th)
Obligatory fasting for Muslims during the month of Ramadan
Voluntary fasting on the 9th of Dhul-Hijjah (for those not performing Hajj)
Voluntary fasting on the 9th and 10th of Muharram
Six days of voluntary fasting in Shawwal
Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, and the Days of Tashreeq

This application uses the Umm al-Qura (Saudi Arabia) calendar system. Please note that there may be slight differences (usually 1 day) compared to other methods or local government announcements. If you find any discrepancies, please inform the developer so we can improve it.
